sections.title: Why the encoder-decoder design

paragraphs.text: The transformer processes sequences in two stages. The encoder handles all positions at once, creating representations for each token. The decoder builds output tokens autoregressively, using both the encoder's knowledge and what it has already generated.
paragraphs.explainArabic: المشفر يعالج كل المواضع دفعة واحدة، يخلق تمثيلات لكل رمز. المشفر يبني الرموز الصادرة خطوة بخطوة، يستخدم معرفة المشفر وما تولده.

paragraphs.text: This design separates understanding from generation. The encoder compresses the input into a shared representation that any decoder head can access.
paragraphs.explainArabic: الفصل بين الفهم والإنتاج. المشفر يضغط الإدخال لتمثيل مشترك يمكن أي رأس مشفر الوصوله.

paragraphs.text: Two key mechanisms enable this separation:
items: Self-attention: Each position attends to all others within its layer.
Cross-attention: The decoder attends to encoder outputs when generating.

keySentences: The encoder processes all positions at once.
takeaways: Decoder uses encoder outputs plus its own history.

studyAid.whyItMatters: The same encoder serves multiple decoder positions, making efficient use of computation for large contexts.

confusion.simpleEnglish: Encoder understands, decoder generates using that understanding.
confusion.simpleArabic: المشفر يفهم، المشفر يولد باستخدام هذا الفهم.
confusion.analogy: A dictionary (encoder) that any writer (decoder) can consult.

prediction.question: What happens if you remove cross-attention?
prediction.answer: The decoder cannot see what the encoder learned, breaking translation-style tasks.

sections.title: Self-attention within the encoder

paragraphs.text: Each encoder layer applies self-attention to its input. Every position computes scores against every other position, normalizes them, and blends the weighted values.
paragraphs.explainArabic: كل طبقة مشفرة تطبق الانتباه الذاتي على إدخالها. كل موضع يحسب درجات مقابل كل موضع آخر، يوحد الدرجات ويمزج القيم المرجحة.

paragraphs.text: For position i in a sequence of length n:
paragraphs.code:
# Compute attention for one position
for j in range(n):  # over all positions
    score = query_i dot key_j  # raw comparison
weight = softmax(score)  # normalize
blended += weight * value_j  # weighted blend

keySentences: Each position attends to all others.
takeaways: All positions contribute to each blended value.

studyAid.whyItMatters: Self-attention captures long-range dependencies without positional encoding limits.

confusion.simpleEnglish: Each token sees the whole sequence, but different heads focus on different patterns.
confusion.simpleArabic: كل رمز يرى التسلسل الكامل، لكن الرؤوس المختلفة تركز على أنماط مختلفة.
confusion.analogy: Multiple readers scanning a document for different types of information.

prediction.question: Why use multiple attention heads instead of one?
prediction.answer: Different heads can learn different relations, like syntax versus semantics.

quiz.prompt: What is the role of cross-attention?
options: The decoder retrieves knowledge from encoder outputs.
The decoder ignores the encoder entirely.
Self-attention operates within a single layer.
answer: The decoder retrieves knowledge from encoder outputs.
quiz.explanationEn: Cross-attention allows the decoder to attend to encoder representations when generating.
quiz.explanationAr: الانتباه المشترك يسمح للمشفر بالانتباه لتمثيلات المشفر عند الإصدار.

quiz.prompt: Each encoder layer applies self-attention to its input.
quiz.explanationEn: Self-attention operates within each encoder layer, enabling global context capture.
quiz.explanationAr: الانتباه الذاتي يعمل داخل كل طبقة مشفرة،月月 يتيح التقاط السياق العام.

quiz.prompt: Match each component to its function.
quiz.explanationEn: Encoder understands, decoder generates, cross-attention bridges them.
quiz.explanationAr: المشفر يفهم، المشفر يولد، الانتباه المشترك يجسر بينهما.
